name: Plastics Advanced Research
old_description: Since 1978, PART Inc. has been a pioneer in the field of plastic injection molding. Founded with a vision to provide unparalleled quality and service, we've grown into a leading provider of custom molding solutions for diverse industries.
about:
Plastics Advanced Research, operating as PART Inc., has been based in Clover, South Carolina since its founding in 1978. Dennis Denton established the company with a vision to provide unparalleled quality and service in plastic injection molding. Today, the business remains family-owned, led by his sons Kacy and Brad Denton, who bring over 60 years of combined industry experience to the operation.

The company provides custom plastic injection molding services from initial concept through finished production. Its capabilities include custom molding, rapid prototyping with fast turnaround times, and both low-volume and high-volume production runs. Work is carried out in a state-of-the-art facility in Clover equipped with the latest technology, though the company does not disclose facility size or headcount.

PART Inc. serves diverse industries with plastic components, though the company does not specify individual sectors in its public materials. Customers range from those needing prototype validation to full-scale production partners.

The firm distinguishes itself by aiming to be one of the best rather than one of the largest molders, a philosophy reflected in a 99.9% satisfaction rating for quality and on-time delivery tracked since 2000. The operation is ISO 9001:2015 certified by Bureau Veritas, and leadership emphasizes integrity, innovation, and collaboration as core values.
